decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By playing powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also using disruption like Thoughtseize and Terminate, this deck aims to apply pressure early on and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The use of cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death add additional layers of disruption and make it difficult for the opponent to mount a defense. Overall, this deck is focused on being proactive and disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively control the board with efficient removal spells and disruptive counterspells, while also deploying threats like Ragavan and Murktide Regent to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck aims to maintain a steady stream of card advantage through cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, allowing it to outlast opponents in the late game. The combination of cheap spells and powerful creatures allows for a versatile and proactive game plan that can adapt to different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to mill the opponent's deck as quickly as possible using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to exile cards from their library. The deck also includes cards like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity to further accelerate the milling process, while also including cards like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push for removal and disruption. The goal is to deplete the opponent's library and win the game by forcing them to draw from an empty deck.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost spells and creatures, while utilizing cards like Underworld Breach and Mishra's Bauble for card advantage and graveyard recursion. The deck aims to play multiple spells in a turn to trigger prowess abilities on creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, overwhelming the opponent with fast, efficient threats. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana fixing and flexibility in deck building.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements in order to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also generating advantage through card draw and mana ramp. By utilizing cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, the deck aims to generate a significant amount of mana to cast devastating spells like Damnation and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes targeted removal and graveyard hate to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's strategies. Additionally, the deck features win conditions such as March of Wretched Sorrow to close out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly mill the opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Drown in the Loch. The deck also includes cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter and Fractured Sanity to further deplete the opponent's library. Additionally, cards like Surgical Extraction and Field of Ruin are included to disrupt the opponent's resources. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with mill effects, ultimately leading to a win by emptying their library.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of resource denial, removal spells, and hand disruption. Utilizing cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to generate mana advantage, along with Field of Ruin to disrupt opponent's lands. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional versatility, while March of Wretched Sorrow and Invoke Despair offer hand disruption. The deck aims to maintain board control through removal spells like Fatal Push and Damnation, while also utilizing Relic of Progenitus to disrupt opponent's graveyard strategies.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The combination of Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Leyline Binding provide control and disruption against opponents while setting up the combo. The mana base is optimized for consistent color access and fetching key lands like Dwarven Mine. The inclusion of versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending adds flexibility to the deck's game plan. The overall strategy revolves around creatively assembling game-winning combinations and outmaneuvering opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play low-cost spells and creatures to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with countermagic and removal. By utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent alongside powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps the deck maintain card advantage and consistency, ensuring it can maintain its aggressive strategy throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to use Indomitable Creativity to combo with Dwarven Mine and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, allowing you to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes Wrenn and Six for card advantage and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect your combo. Spell Pierce and Prismari Command provide interaction and disruption, while Leyline Binding helps to control the board. This deck relies on creativity and clever plays to overwhelm your opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively cast cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. The deck focuses on utilizing the cascade mechanic to continuously cast spells for free, such as Violent Outburst or Shardless Agent, to put pressure on the opponent. By cascading into impactful spells like Crashing Footfalls or Murktide Regent, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, the inclusion of versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Bonecrusher Giant provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The key strategy is to efficiently use cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to draw into threats and answers, while utilizing Underworld Breach to recur important spells. The deck aims to control the board with removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while leveraging the graveyard with cards like Ledger Shredder. Overall, the deck seeks to apply pressure early and maintain a strong tempo throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow and Kroxa to pressure the opponent early on while disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also incorporates efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to control the board. The inclusion of Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides additional card advantage and threats. The use of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to filter through the deck and find the necessary pieces to win the game. The deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures and spells with cascade mechanics to overwhelm the opponent and maintain tempo. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury to apply constant pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Prismari Command to handle various situations efficiently. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around aggressive plays and cascading into impactful spells to secure victory.

The deck focuses on cycling through cards to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then cast Living End to bring them all into play at once. It utilizes cards with the cycling ability, such as Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries, to draw through the deck efficiently. The goal is to set up a board state that overwhelms the opponent with large creatures while disrupting their strategy with cards like Force of Negation. The deck aims to win by out-valuing the opponent through its recursion and card advantage.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal while quickly deploying threats to pressure the opponent. By efficiently controlling the board and applying pressure through aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also utilizes card selection and graveyard synergy to maintain consistent tempo and resource advantage. It emphasizes proactive plays and efficient use of mana to outpace and overwhelm the opponent in a fast-paced Modern format.
